title: scott-continuous-nuclear-dyad-shadow
description: The Scott-continuous shadow of aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell, descended through transfinite-bounded-nuclear-square-shadow. The two nuclei collapse toward each other at the ω-limit: Fix(σ) and Fix(Δ) coincide; the four-corner quartet structure degenerates to a nuclear dyad. The semiotic-universe-least-fixed-point — the sign-theoretic analog of autopoietic self-production — lives at this regime.
